title: A worker's factdiff.py anchor --file adds anchor rows only for the facts its item wrote, not for untouched facts of the file
goal: factdiff.py anchor --file F --lines N[,N...] anchors only the facts on those lines of F and exits 2 for a line that holds no fact, as gate g1 records, and the worker role file's done bar has a worker pass the lines of the facts its item wrote or reworded, so no anchor row of an untouched fact lands in its commit. SP-xo45jvbj and SP-6jfnx5i3: anchor --file anchored untouched facts and done refused the rows.

run:
import subprocess as s,sys
F='kb/public/security/secret-shapes-in-text.md'
def a(*x):
    p=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/factdiff.py','anchor','--file',F,*x,'--dry-run'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120);return p.returncode,p.stdout+p.stderr
fact=a('--lines','17');nofact=a('--lines','3')
t=open('agents/worker.md',encoding='utf-8').read();rule='--lines' in t[t.find('3. **Done bar.**'):t.find('4. **')]
print('fact line',fact[0],'| no-fact line',nofact[0],'| worker rule names --lines',rule);sys.exit(0 if fact[0]==0 and 'sources=0' in fact[1] and nofact[0]==2 and rule else 1)
